threats.title: Crafted image triggers a flaw in image processing
threats.description: An end user submits a crafted image that exploits a memory-safety flaw in the serving path's image processing, leading to remote code execution or denial of service on the web server.
preconditions: image parsing occurs on the serving path without sandboxing or input hardening the documents describe
attack_path: craft a malformed image
submit it through the public API
threats.impact: Service availability and production host integrity are compromised.

threats.title: Compromised third-party library reaches training or serving
threats.description: A poisoned third-party library or tool is pulled into the image-gathering or model pipeline and compromises training data, the trained model, or the hosts that run the pipeline.
preconditions: third-party tools and libraries are consumed without a verification step the documents describe
attack_path: poison a third-party tool or library the experimental environment pulls
let the gathering or training path consume it
threats.impact: Training data integrity, model integrity, and host integrity are compromised.

threats.title: Stored training images tampered with or deleted
threats.description: An attacker with write access to the training images blob alters or deletes stored images to skew training results or deny service to the training pipeline.
preconditions: blob access control fails or is misconfigured
image integrity is not validated before training
attack_path: obtain write access to the training images blob
alter or delete stored images
threats.impact: Model accuracy and training availability are degraded.

threats.title: Notebook modified to carry a backdoor
threats.description: An attacker who reaches the experimental environment modifies a notebook file so that training runs execute attacker code — a keylogger, a data stealer, or a model backdoor.
preconditions: notebook content is not integrity-checked before execution
the password-authenticated experimental boundary is crossed
attack_path: cross the public-to-experimental boundary
modify a notebook
wait for a training run to execute it
threats.impact: Model integrity, engineer credentials, and the experimental environment are compromised.

threats.title: Persisted model files read or modified
threats.description: An attacker or insider reads the serialized model from the model blob to steal intellectual property, or modifies it to degrade prediction accuracy in production.
preconditions: access to the model blob is obtained despite the documented access control, or through a path it does not cover
attack_path: reach the model storage blob
read or replace the serialized model
threats.impact: Model confidentiality and classification integrity are compromised.

threats.title: Systematic perturbation drives misclassification
threats.description: An attacker probes the public classification API with systematically perturbed images until inputs reliably produce wrong classifications.
preconditions: the public API permits enough classification attempts for iterative probing
attack_path: submit perturbed variants of an image
observe classifications and refine until misclassification is reliable
threats.impact: Classification integrity and trust in system output are degraded.

threats.title: Uploaded images exposed from the cache
threats.description: An attacker or malicious insider reads user-submitted images from the in-memory Redis cache before they expire.
preconditions: access to the Redis cache or to process memory on the serving host
attack_path: reach the cache or serving host memory
read cached user images

threats.title: SSH key theft from a developer machine
threats.description: An attacker compromises an engineer's machine, steals SSH private keys, and uses them to reach the Bastion as an authorized user.
preconditions: a developer machine holding production SSH keys is compromised
attack_path: compromise an engineer's machine
steal the SSH private key
authenticate to the Bastion as that engineer
threats.impact: Production administrative access, model integrity, and storage integrity are exposed.

threats.title: Bastion compromised through its exposed SSH surface
threats.description: An attacker exploits a vulnerability in the Bastion's reachable SSH service to escalate privileges or impersonate authorized users.
preconditions: the Bastion SSH surface is reachable by the attacker and carries an exploitable weakness
attack_path: reach the Bastion's SSH service
exploit a service vulnerability
escalate or impersonate an authorized user
threats.impact: Production administrative access and audit log integrity are compromised.
